title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Through our products & services, we can make a difference in the lives and futures of our clients – in real terms.

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar role(s) in rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code, but is also passionate about helping end users who are in need of help.

You will design, implement and manage our growing corporate cloud-first infrastructure and networks. You will have a passion for innovation and creative problem solving, as well as be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment. You will need to be a highly motivated, dependable and an experienced technologist who shares our passion and wants to be a part of a fast moving and highly execution-oriented team.

You will work closely with your Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams, including, but not limited to, Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner who is looking for a supportive environment to continue to grow their IT skills and expertise. This role will report to the Director of IT.

About The Role

You will be customer-facing, and the first line of support; you own support, and you are passionate about providing an outstanding support experience to our employees via Slack, Jira, etc. We're all Mac. You are a pro at troubleshooting, using the terminal, and making macOS work in the enterprise. You will be responsible for procuring and delivering technology equipment. You will own the experience of tech onboarding of all new employees as well as tech retrieval of all outgoing employees. You'll design, test, build, and document programs and policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge with your experience and background. You'll support and manage SaaS applications – Google Workspace (GSuite), Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc. You will work with and manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools – MDM, EMM, Jamf, etc. You'll own and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.) You'll detail your solutions, craft help articles and automate busywork. Manage, respond to, and fix critical incidents and issues as needed, through to completion. You're comfortable juggling help desk tickets and can effectively prioritise them. You'll work on projects over sprints, and detail your work in tools like Jira (you're experienced with agile methods and sprints). You'll set and work to your own objective and key results with minimal direction, and can align them to the team and the company goals.

What You Bring To Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Ability to utilize open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • You are able to integrate SSO into Okta, create workflows in Okta.
  • You know how to work with APIs, and integrate one system to another.
  • You've provided remote support to people in multiple countries, across time zones, and you're familiar with shipping and receiving hardware and customs.
  • Unusually great communication skills across all media — you can make your ideas clear, and you can help people who might be frustrated or time poor without losing your cool.
  • You write very well, whether it's in tickets, email or Slack. You write in a clear, friendly, and concise manner, and are sensitive to different cultures.
  • A desire to provide a magical experience for others — when they win, you win.
  • You take security seriously, and you know what PGP is.
  • You understand networking fundamentals and basic troubleshooting — TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching.
  • You must be able to competently and demonstrably know the troubleshooting steps and layers of the OSI model — you know how to methodically troubleshoot problems without wasting someone's time.
  • You can self-manage, and can accurately scope your project, priorities, and work across multiple teams. Strong organisational and task-management skills are critical.
  • You're comfortable dealing with ambiguity, and sometimes making the right decision without all the data.

Nice To Haves

  • Some familiarity with AWS (you will not need certifications, but you will have used these environments a bit.)
  • You've used tools like GAM and command-line interfaces to do lots of work with less effort.
  • Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.

Culture Fit

  • Have a passion for progress by being adaptable and resilient, comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high-growth, fast-paced environment.
  • Have a builder's mindset, excited to create, iterate, and scale IT practices.
  • Be a collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity.
  • Demonstrate integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information across diverse legal and cultural contexts.
  • Have worked in a remote environment before.

A Taste Of What We Provide

  • Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package that starts on your first day!
  • We offer a competitive PTO package that ensures you have the time off you deserve.
  • Ownership in the company. Through shared equity, Ledn employees are stakeholders in the company and the future of the digital economy.
  • We offer every employee the opportunity to work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).
  • A career that provides you with purpose in your job. We remove barriers so you love what you do.

We are an equal opportunity employment organization and pride ourselves on inclusivity, diversity, and the success that comes from diversity. LOCATION Worcester

JOB DESCRIPTION SUMMARY

The Product Lead, Slate, is responsible for the strategic oversight and continuous improvement of the Slate CRM platform, supporting functions such as admissions, enrollment, communications, and student engagement. This role will report to the Director, Enterprise Cloud Systems. The role leads the full product lifecycle—from ideation and development to deployment and optimization—to ensure the platform aligns with institutional goals and delivers measurable value. In this capacity, the Product Lead may manage a team, including direct reports such as system administrators or analysts who support Slate. They provide leadership, coaching, and performance management to ensure the team delivers secure, scalable, and user-centered solutions. The Product Lead works closely with these team members to align technical execution with product strategy and ensure seamless delivery of enhancements and support. The role requires close collaboration with stakeholders across business and technology domains to define and communicate a clear product vision. The Product Lead plays a key role in shaping the end-to-end user experience and ensuring that Slate evolves to meet the institution’s changing needs.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the Product Lead for Slate, managing tenant configuration, security administration, and release planning.
  • Provide technical support and troubleshoot issues related to Slate and other enterprise cloud systems as needed.
  • Collaborate closely with the Graduate Studies team—including Recruiting & Marketing and Admissions—Summer Studies, and University Marketing to ensure system functionality aligns with strategic goals and operational needs.
  • Define and manage the Slate product roadmap, ensuring alignment with institutional goals and user needs.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality solutions, monitor performance, and manage transitions from development to production.
  • Serve as a liaison between business units and technical teams, translating requirements and resolving integration or customization challenges.

  • Evaluate and prototype new Slate features and technologies to support innovation and continuous improvement.
  • Lead major system releases, ensuring new functionality meets business and technical requirements.
  • Mentor team members who support Slate operations and development.
  • Ensure the team maintains system performance, security, and compliance standards.
  • Align team activities with product goals, ensuring operational readiness for new features and updates.
  • Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, information systems or related field.
  • 6+ years of relevant experience in IT, business, or higher education, with a strong understanding of end-user needs and value drivers.
  • 3+ years in progressively responsible roles across business and/or IT functions. Business-only backgrounds are acceptable if they include significant technology collaboration.
  • Proven ability to engage and influence senior stakeholders in support of strategic initiatives.
  • Experience managing technical teams or direct reports is strongly preferred.
  • Familiarity with CRM platforms (preferably Slate), design thinking principles, and modern software delivery methodologies.
  • Strong communication, time management, and stakeholder engagement skills.

Salary: $95,000 (depending on experience)

Benefits: WPI offers a comprehensive package including 4 weeks of paid time off, an additional week at the end of December, 13 paid holidays, health, dental, and vision insurance, a 9.5% retirement match after one year, disability and life insurance, tuition assistance (including full WPI tuition for dependents after 3 years), and free access to the fitness center.

description:

TechnipFMC is committed to driving real change in the energy industry. Our ambition is to build a sustainable future through relentless innovation and global collaboration – and we want you to be part of it. You’ll be joining a culture that values curiosity, expertise, and ideas as well as equal opportunities, inclusion, and authenticity. Bring your unique energy to our team of more than 21,000 people worldwide, and discover a rewarding, fulfilling, and varied career that you can take in anywhere you want to go.

Job Purpose

We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Hedge Accounting Specialist to join our finance team. The successful candidate will be responsible for the end-to-end process of hedge accounting, including derivative instruments analysis, hedge effectiveness assessments, and accounting under ASC 815 (or IFRS 9, as applicable).

Job Description

  • Derivative Instruments Accounting & Analysis: Monitor, account for, and analyze all derivative transactions including forwards, swaps, options, and futures. Ensure proper classification and valuation in accordance with hedge accounting standards.
  • OCI (Other Comprehensive Income) Analysis: Prepare and review OCI entries related to hedge accounting. Analyze fluctuations and report impacts on financial statements.
  • Hedge Cost Allocation: Analyze and allocate hedge costs between business units or cost centers. Track cost of hedging strategies (e.g., forward points, option premiums) and ensure correct accounting treatment.
  • Spot and Forward Points Rate Analysis: Perform in-depth analysis on spot vs. forward points movements and their impact on hedging relationships and financial results.
  • Mark-to-Market (MTM) Analysis: Calculate and explain changes in the fair value of derivative positions. Work with valuation models and external pricing sources.
  • Hedge Effectiveness Testing & Documentation: Execute prospective and retrospective effectiveness tests (qualitative and/or quantitative). Maintain comprehensive documentation for audit and compliance purposes.
  • Collaboration & Reporting: Work closely with Treasury, FP&A, and external auditors to ensure the accuracy and transparency of hedge accounting results. Prepare reports and dashboards as needed for internal stakeholders.
  • Compliance & Controls: Ensure adherence to internal controls and compliance with accounting standards such as ASC 815 or IFRS 9. Support external and internal audits as required.
  • FX Analysis - Conduct detailed Foreign Exchange variance analysis to identify and explain deviations in currency conversion impacts across global transactions enabling data-driven insights.

You are meant for this job if:

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or Economics (MBA is a plus)
  • Experience in hedge accounting, financial reporting, or treasury operations
  • Strong understanding of derivative instruments and financial risk management
  • In-depth knowledge of hedge accounting under ASC 815 and/or IFRS 9
  • Proficient in Excel and financial systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Kyriba, or similar treasury systems)

description:
TRM Labs is a blockchain intelligence company committed to fighting crime and creating a safer world. By leveraging blockchain data, threat intelligence, and advanced analytics, our products empower governments, financial institutions, and crypto businesses to combat illicit activity and global security threats. At TRM, you’ll join a mission‑driven, fast‑paced team made up of experts in law enforcement, data science, engineering, and financial intelligence, tackling complex global challenges daily. Whether analyzing blockchain data, developing cutting‑edge tools, or collaborating with global organizations, you’ll have the opportunity to make a meaningful and lasting impact.

We are seeking an Accounts Payable Specialist to play a critical role in ensuring accurate, timely payments and building scalable procurement processes at TRM. As a fully remote, global company, TRM requires an AP function that is both efficient and strategic—balancing day‑to‑day execution with process improvements that strengthen vendor relationships, support healthy cash flow, and raise standards for financial discipline.

You will join TRM’s high‑performing Finance team, which leads with ownership, accountability, and a commitment to excellence. Partnering closely with Finance, HR, and cross‑functional teams, you’ll ensure invoices are processed on time, vendors are supported seamlessly, and AP systems evolve to meet the needs of a fast‑growing organization.

The impact you will have:

  • Own payment operations : Consistently achieve >95% on‑time and accurate payments while completing AP close within target timelines to support cash flow visibility.
  • Enhance vendor & employee experience : Manage Zip effectively, onboard vendors quickly, and resolve invoice/payment inquiries while maintaining >90% compliance with card submissions.
  • Streamline procurement : Develop and implement procurement processes, including vendor negotiations, policy rollouts, and measurable cost savings that establish best practices at TRM.
  • Drive system & process improvements : Identify and implement automation or workflow enhancements to reduce manual work, strengthen liability forecasting, and improve scalability.
  • Support month‑end close : Prepare and review accruals, manage prepaid expense amortization, and reconcile accounts payable to ensure accurate, timely, and compliant financial reporting.
  • Partner cross‑functionally : Provide timely, accurate AP reporting and collaborate with stakeholders across Finance, HR, and other teams to ensure a seamless procurement and payment experience.

What we’re looking for:

  • 3–5 years of accounts payable experience, ideally in a SaaS, startup, or high‑growth environment.
  • Strong understanding of AP processes and procurement workflows; experience with Zip, Airbase, Netsuite or similar systems is a plus.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy, with a proven track record of processing payments and invoices reliably and on time.
  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills to identify process gaps, reconcile issues, and recommend improvements.
  • Clear, proactive communicator who builds trusted relationships with vendors and internal stakeholders.
  • Ownership mindset, able to manage multiple AP responsibilities simultaneously while driving continuous improvement.

Learn about TRM Speed in this position:

  • High‑Priority Requests: For P1 items, able to immediately jump in and resolve employee/vendor requests for urgent, time‑sensitive purchases within the same day, without compromising accuracy.
  • Policy Rollouts: When a new procurement or AP policy is introduced, able to implement the change in systems and workflows within 1 week of rollout.
  • Vendor Invoice Processing & Communication: Upload vendor invoices to the system within 24–48 hours of receipt and respond to vendor email inquiries within 1 business day.

Life at TRM Labs

Leadership Principles

Our Leadership Principles shape everything we do—how we make decisions, collaborate, and operate day to day.

  • Impact‑Oriented Trailblazer – We put customers first, driving for speed, focus, and adaptability.
  • Master Craftsperson – We prioritize speed, high standards, and distributed ownership.
  • Inspiring Colleague – We value humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset.

Accelerate your Career

At TRM, you’ll do work that matters—disrupting terrorist networks, recovering stolen funds, and protecting people around the world. You will:

Join our mission!

We’re looking for team members who thrive in fast‑paced, high‑impact environments and love building from the ground up. TRM is remote‑first, with an exceptionally talented global team. If you enjoy solving tough problems and seeing your work make a difference for billions of people, we want you here. Don’t worry if your experience doesn’t perfectly match a job description— we value passion, problem‑solving, and unique career paths. If you’re excited about TRM’s mission, we want to hear from you.

description:
Join to apply for the Hedge Accounting Specialist role at TechnipFMC

Job Purpose

We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Hedge Accounting Specialist to join our finance team. The successful candidate will be responsible for the end-to-end process of hedge accounting, including derivative instruments analysis, hedge effectiveness assessments, and accounting under ASC 815 (or IFRS 9, as applicable).

Job Description

  • Derivative Instruments Accounting & Analysis: Monitor, account for, and analyze all derivative transactions including forwards, swaps, options, and futures. Ensure proper classification and valuation in accordance with hedge accounting standards.
  • OCI (Other Comprehensive Income) Analysis: Prepare and review OCI entries related to hedge accounting. Analyze fluctuations and report impacts on financial statements.
  • Hedge Cost Allocation: Analyze and allocate hedge costs between business units or cost centers. Track cost of hedging strategies (e.g., forward points, option premiums) and ensure correct accounting treatment.
  • Spot and Forward Points Rate Analysis: Perform in-depth analysis on spot vs. forward points movements and their impact on hedging relationships and financial results.
  • Mark-to-Market (MTM) Analysis: Calculate and explain changes in the fair value of derivative positions. Work with valuation models and external pricing sources.
  • Hedge Effectiveness Testing & Documentation: Execute prospective and retrospective effectiveness tests (qualitative and/or quantitative). Maintain comprehensive documentation for audit and compliance purposes.
  • Collaboration & Reporting: Work closely with Treasury, FP&A, and external auditors to ensure the accuracy and transparency of hedge accounting results. Prepare reports and dashboards as needed for internal stakeholders.
  • Compliance & Controls: Ensure adherence to internal controls and compliance with accounting standards such as ASC 815 or IFRS 9. Support external and internal audits as required.
  • FX Analysis: Conduct detailed Foreign Exchange variance analysis to identify and explain deviations in currency conversion impacts across global transactions enabling data‑driven insights.

You Are Meant For This Job If

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or Economics (MBA is a plus)
  • Experience in hedge accounting, financial reporting, or treasury operations
  • Strong understanding of derivative instruments and financial risk managementIn-depth knowledge of hedge accounting under ASC 815 and/or IFRS 9

Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital.

For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page.

The Problems You’ll Solve

As an Implementations Project Manager, you will focus efforts on supporting new Investor Services customers in their journey into Carta services. You will drive operational excellence within our fast-growing Investor Services business by coordinating, facilitating and managing on-boarding activities that are critical to achieving success for both our customers and Carta within a tight deadline.

  • Support new Fund Administration, Portfolio Insights, and Valuations' clients by on-boarding them onto Carta – i.e., implementation of client’s limited partners list, investments, capitalization table and securities

  • Effectively liaise between sales and Investor Services teams as the bridge post-sales through implementation
  • Coordinate and manage multiple/simultaneous implementation projects by continually communicating with and motivating clients
  • Continuously look for ways to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the on-boarding process
  • Work closely with product and engineering to improve the on-boarding experience for customers

The Impact You’ll Have

You’ll play a critical role in the transformation of the financial services industry through partnering with our new clients and helping them implement our software. In this role you will be responsible for interacting with a fund’s back office (CFO, fund manager) to collect their historical data, provide advisory support, and ultimately deliver accurate data to both the client and internal stakeholders.

About You

From sale close, to implementation, and continued customer success, the ideal Implementations Project Manager will exhibit excellent communication skills, a high degree of problem-solving, velocity, embracing change and will constantly seek ways to better their process to provide customers with a world-class on-boarding experience.

  • Proven success in a project management capacity

  • Great people skills – high degree of empathy and great communication skills

  • Incredible organizational skills, high attention to detail, and an ability to complete competing priorities quickly and autonomously
  • Passionate, tactical, and direct, with an ambitious attitude and a proven history to go above and beyond baseline requirements
  • Interested in working with enterprise software

Salary

Carta’s compensation package includes a market competitive salary, equity for all full time roles, exceptional benefits, and, for applicable roles, commissions plans. If you are located in New York, New York, our minimum cash compensation salary range for this role is $81,000 - $85,000 (if applicable, + commission). description:
Location

Remote - US, New York

Employment Type

Full time

Department

Acquisition

Compensation

Here at Gaia, our employees are the foundation of our success. We believe it's super important that you are happy, healthy, and motivated.

As such, on top of a competitive market bench-marked salary, we offer private healthcare, fertility support and other benefits.

Additionally, we offer all new hires a set up budget in addition to an annual personal development budget to build your skills, knowledge, and potential. We’re working hard on our reward and recognition framework to make sure that those who are excelling above and beyond get what they deserve.

Our vision

Everyone who wants a family should have the chance to try. For the 1 in 6 families that struggle to conceive, fertility treatments are an option but they are expensive. We created the world’s first IVF insurance allowing more people who wish to be parents to pursue treatment with increased financial flexibility. Because the difference between having a child or not should not be how rich you are.

The role

From the very first moment someone considers Gaia as part of their fertility journey, we aim to offer clarity and care. That’s where you come in.

We’re looking for a BDR (Patient Support) to connect with prospects as they consider Gaia for their fertility journey.

You’ll be the first human touchpoint for patients early in their fertility journey; answering questions, building trust, and making sure they feel supported every step of the way.

This is a unique opportunity to support people at one of the most pivotal moments in their lives and help shape how Gaia shows up for them.

  • You’ll work closely with our Marketing team to manage the prospect pipeline for any patient starting their fertility journey in the early stages.
  • You’ll be acting as the main point of contact for prospects and guiding them seamlessly through the initial stages of their journey.
  • You’ll as a point of contact for clinic staff at your assigned clinics to support members book their initial consultations.
  • You’ll book initial calls between “ready to go” patients and our Member Growth Team.

Your responsibilities:

  • Manage a marketing pipeline of Gaia prospects.
  • Qualify potential members at their early stages throughout inbound forms and outbound sales calls.
  • Support MQLs to book a clinic consultation.
  • Book initial calls between Gaia Prospects and Member Growth Associates.
  • Manage all communication with Prospects via calls and email.
  • Effectively carry out processes to track prospects' initial journey and share data with clinics and the rest of the team.
  • Identify opportunities for increasing our sales pipeline to drive overall Member growth.

You’ll be a great candidate for this role if you:

  • Have minimum 1 year of experience qualifying leads and potential prospects over the phone and via inbound forms required .
  • Experience in the healthcare or fertility space (nice to have).
  • Are empathetic and deeply care about our Members - the IVF experience is incredibly stressful and empathy for what they are going through is a must.
  • Are a self-starter - you’ll be working as part of a small team but also a specific growth project, so we’ll be looking to you to help set us up for success.
  • Have strong interpersonal skills - you’ll constantly be communicating with patients, clinic staff and the rest of our company via email and phone calls.

Compensation Range: $60K - $65K

Through our products & services, we can make a difference in the lives and futures of our clients — in real terms. Our team at Ledn is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds.

Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services!

Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full‑time Manager of IT.
The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud‑based IT systems and tools.
A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar role(s) in rapidly growing, security‑first environments.
The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code.
But, just as passionate about helping end users who are in need of help. You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud first infrastructure and networks.
You will have a passion for innovation and creative problem solving, as well as be adaptable to the ever‑changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment.
You will need to be a highly motivated, dependable and an experienced technologist who shares our passion and wants to be a part of a fast‑moving and highly execution‑oriented team. You will work closely with your Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams, including, but not limited to, Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR.

About the Role

This role will report to the Director of IT. You will be customer‑facing, and the first line of support; you own support and you are passionate about providing an outstanding support experience to our employees — via Slack, Jira, etc. We’re all Mac.
You are a pro at troubleshooting, using the terminal, and making macOS work in the enterprise. You will be responsible for procuring and delivering technology equipment. You will own the experience of tech onboarding of all new employees as well as tech retrieval of all outgoing employees.
You’ll design, test, build, and document programs and policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge with your experience and background. You’ll detail your solutions, craft help articles and automate busywork.
Manage, respond to, and fix critical incidents and issues as needed, through to completion. You’re comfortable juggling help desk tickets and can effectively prioritise them. You’ll work on projects over sprints, and detail your work in tools like Jira (you’re experienced with agile methods and sprints).

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Ability to utilise open‑source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • Do you integrate SSO into Okta, create workflows in Okta.
  • You know how to work with APIs, and integrate one system to another.
  • You’ve provided remote support to people in multiple countries, across time zones, and you’re familiar with shipping and receiving hardware and customs.
  • Unusually great communication skills across all media — you can make your ideas clear, and you can help people who might be frustrated or time‑poor without losing your cool.
  • You write very well, whether it’s in tickets, email or Slack.
  • You write in a clear, friendly, and concise manner, and are sensitive to different cultures.
  • A desire to provide a magical experience for others — when they win, you win.
  • You take security seriously, and you know what PGP is.
  • You understand networking fundamentals and basic troubleshooting — TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching.
  • You must be able to competently and demonstrably know the troubleshooting steps and layers of the OSI model — you know how to methodically troubleshoot problems without wasting someone’s time.
  • You can self‑manage, and can accurately scope your project, priorities, and work across multiple teams.
  • Strong organisational and task‑management skills are critical.
  • You’re comfortable dealing with ambiguity, and sometimes making the right decision without all the data.

Nice to Haves

  • Some familiarity with AWS (you will not need certifications, but you will have used these environments a bit.)
  • You’ve used tools like GAM and command‑line interfaces to do lots of work with less effort.
  • Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.

Culture Fit

We’re looking for more than just operational excellence — we want a leader who thrives in the startup or tech environment and embodies our values.
The ideal candidate will:
• Have a passion for progress by being adaptable and resilient, and is comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high‑growth, fast‑paced environment.
• Have a builder’s mindset, excited to create, iterate, and scale IT practices.
• Be a collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity.

We offer a competitive PTO package that ensures you have the time off you deserve. Ownership in the company.

ABOUT HAPPY MONEY

Happy Money is a leading consumer finance company dedicated to helping people achieve their goals through responsible lending. Through its fully-digital platform, Happy Money partners with credit unions, banks and asset managers to originate high-quality credit solutions, diversify their portfolios and expand their impact and reach nationwide.

Backed by investors like TruStage Ventures, Happy Money enables financial institutions to grow as a force for good in their communities while helping people use money as a tool for their happiness. Together with their community-focused capital partner network, Happy Money has originated over $6 billion in loans representing more than 300,000 members who have taken greater control of their financial futures. Learn more at happymoney.com.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Senior Lead Analyst in the Pricing & Conversion team at Happy Money, you will be responsible for developing, analyzing, and optimizing our application conversion and pricing strategy. Sitting within the Risk and Analytics team, you will own analytics and strategy changes, periodic reporting, and initiatives that enhance our funnel conversion and optimize leads.

You will work cross-functionally with Credit Operations, Product, and Engineering to drive proactive, data-driven strategies that support responsible growth for Happy Money and our lending partners.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Conversion:

  • Optimize our conversion rate by continuously streamlining our origination process and improving user experience.
  • Lead efforts to improve automation opportunities while balancing risk and customer experience.
  • Manage and optimize existing strategies effectively by designing A/B tests to understand the right risk-return balance.
  • Identify and evaluate new vendors / data sources and create business cases and present them to senior management.
  • Conduct ad-hoc analysis related to risk management, product, and operations.

Pricing:

  • Develop and implement credit strategies leveraging data, machine learning models and advanced analytics tools to mitigate losses and maintain excellent customer experience.
  • Continue to innovate by testing new data, analytical approaches and models.
  • Monitor and analyze portfolio performance at a granular segment level on an ongoing basis. Identify trends and conduct root-cause analysis to isolate key performance drivers.
  • Communicate findings and recommendations to the Risk Management and broader Happy Money community in a clear and concise manner.

ABOUT YOU

  • 5+ years of experience managing credit risk strategies.
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering or Economics.
  • Strong proficiency with Python & SQL and the ability to analyze large, complex datasets and derive actionable insights.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills coupled with deep experience working in Originations strategies and/or processes.
  • Experience with credit orchestration and decisioning tools (e.g., Oscilar, LoanPro, Strata, Zoot, ACAPS) preferred.

BENEFITS & PERKS

  • Generous medical, dental, and vision insurance options
  • Eligible for Annual Bonus
  • 401k Plan with a matching contribution
  • Flexible PTO
  • Monthly Health and Wellness Days
  • 12 Weeks Paid Parental Leave
  • Company-paid short & long term disability and life insurance
  • Monthly tech stipend to help cover expenses for remote work
  • Happy Money is a 100% fully distributed workforce

Base Salary Range

$165,000-$180,000 USD

Conheça o XP Future - Rio de Janeiro, uma iniciativa disruptiva para profissionais com alto skill comercial e que desejam se tornar assessores de investimentos.

Essa é uma oportunidade para profissionais que estão em busca de uma transição de carreira e possuem experiência comercial para migrarem para o mercado financeiro.

Na XP Inc. você terá todo o suporte para uma rápida integração e consolidação de seu novo escopo em assessoria, desenvolvendo e aprimorando habilidades de vendas, prospecção de clientes, aprofundamento nos produtos de investimentos e, principalmente, uma imersão no dia a dia do mercado financeiro. Além disso, o programa conta com uma esteira robusta de carreira para que você se torne um profissional comercial de sucesso na corretora, e tire a certificação CPA-20 para se tornar um assessor referência no mercado!

Se você já possui experiência comercial em outros segmentos e deseja fazer uma transição de carreira para o mercado financeiro, conheça os pré-requisitos para iniciar no XP Future logo abaixo!

  • Graduação superior completa ou estar cursando o último ano em período noturno;
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar presencialmente no Rio de Janeiro;
  • Experiência comercial (diferencial como Hunter - prospecção de novos negócios);
  • Curiosidade sobre o mundo dos investimentos;
  • Interesse por realizar uma transição de carreira;
  • Estar atuando em outros segmentos de mercado (Meios de pagamentos, adquirência, bebidas, fintechs, etc);
  • Não ser um Assessor de Investimentos ou Agente Autônomo (AAI)

Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento sobre produtos financeiros (RF, RV, fundos e outros);
  • CPA-20 ou CEA (Caso o candidato aprovado não tenha a certificação do CPA-20, fornecemos o curso de forma gratuita, em parceria com a Academia Rafael Toro)

Desafios e Impacto

  • Atuação no segmento de Assessoria de Investimentos, sendo responsável por aconselhar e auxiliar a gestão de patrimônio dos clientes;
  • Elaboração de portfólio de investimentos em linha com o perfil e objetivo dos clientes;
  • Análise de alocações externas, elaboração de estudos comparativos exclusivos e identificando oportunidades;
  • Acompanhamento de tendências de mercado, se mantendo sempre informado sobre atualidades do cenário econômico;
  • Disciplina para manter uma alta frequência de contato com clientes de forma online e presencial.
  • Obs.: a contratação é CLT.

Essa vaga é destinada a um pool de rede de talentos a nível Brasil, então pode ser que o retorno demore um pouco a mais do que outras vagas da XP! Em paralelo, também estão abertas as vagas dos XDays XP Future (vagas que acontecerão processos seletivos presenciais na cidade divulgada) para você se aplicar! Essas oportunidades se encontram aqui: Oportunidades XP Inc. ou

Triagem inicial : Análise do currículo para verificar a adequação às qualificações e requisitos da vaga.

Testes gerais : Avaliação do alinhamento cultural com o teste da Mindsight e teste de raciocínio lógico da Predictive Index.

Entrevista com a equipe de Recrutamento : Discussão sobre as expectativas em relação à vaga e aos objetivos profissionais.

Entrevista com a liderança : Uma conversa para discutir sua visão e como você pode contribuir para a equipe e a empresa.

Entrevista com Head Comercial : Conversa para discutir sobre o seu perfil e características necessárias para contribuir com a operação.

Entrevista focada em cultura : Exploração dos valores e princípios da empresa para garantir um bom encaixe cultural.

Oferta : Apresentação da proposta de trabalho, incluindo detalhes sobre remuneração e benefícios.

Por fim, abaixo segue o vídeo sobre o Fator XP! Para você se reconhecer cada vez mais no nosso propósito como empresa e cultura:

  • Saúde e bem-estar: plano de saúde, plano odontológico, Gympass, Zenklub, VA, VR, New Value, seguro de vida.
  • Maternidade e Paternidade: auxílio creche para pais e mães, licença maternidade de 6 meses, licença paternidade de 20 dias.
  • Só na XP Inc.: assessoria de investimento e acesso a fundos de investimentos exclusivos.

Jornada de trabalho com flexibilidade

O nosso modelo de trabalho varia de acordo com a função: presencial para frentes de negócio e híbrido para as demais equipes. É importante ressaltar que todos os colaboradores precisam morar na localidade da vaga (nossa sede está localizada na cidade de São Paulo e é onde temos o maior número de posições), já que temos atividades que exigem a presença física para promover a colaboração e os rituais da nossa cultura. Esses encontros são organizados de acordo com as orientações dos líderes e as particularidades de cada rotina, para que nossos colaboradores possam exercer suas jornadas de trabalho com liberdade e autonomia.

title: Venue Operations Manager – 8 Host Cities (Brazil)
description:
Venue Operations Manager – 8 Host Cities (Brazil)

Join to apply for the Venue Operations Manager – 8 Host Cities (Brazil) role at FIFA Women's World Cup™

Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Location: Brazil

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”). Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Reporting to Senior Venue Operations Manager, and working alongside the FIFA Tournament & Venue Operations team in Zurich, the Venue Operations Manager is responsible for ensuring that the stadium is delivered in full compliance with FIFA Hosting Requirements and for leading the operational delivery of all FWWC2027 matches and non-matchday activities at the venue.

The tournament will be staged across 8 stadiums in Brazil, and we’re recruiting one Venue Operations Manager for each host city:

  • Belo Horizonte - Estádio Mineirão
  • Brasília - Estádio Nacional
  • Fortaleza - Arena Castelão
  • Porto Alegre - Estádio Beira-Rio
  • Recife - Arena de Pernambuco
  • Rio de Janeiro - Estádio do Maracanã
  • Salvador - Arena Fonte Nova
  • São Paulo - Arena Itaquera

Please apply only if you currently live in one of these cities or can relocate there independently.

The position requires the effective and efficient management of all venue operations, ensuring seamless coordination with FIFA’s functional areas as well as internal and external stakeholders. Key areas of focus include transparency, communication, issue escalation, problem-solving, innovation, and the use of reporting tools to guarantee operational excellence.

The Venue Operations Manager will act as a coordinator, facilitator, and decision-maker at the stadium. Together with the FIFA27 Senior Venue Manager, the FIFA FWWC Lead Venue Management team, and the FIFA27 Head of Operations, this role holds ultimate responsibility for venue event planning, operational readiness, and on-site implementation, in close collaboration with all stakeholders.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Responsible for the operational delivery of each match day and non-match day at the venue.
  • Will liaise with all functional areas including Competitions, Broadcast, Media, Dressing & Signage, Fan Operations, Pitch Management, Partnerships Rights Delivery, Technical Services & Overlay, Stadium Entertainment, Ticketing, Hospitality, Technology, FTI (Football Technology Innovation), Catering as well as other functional areas such as Services (Logistics, Transport, Guest Management) and Safety, Security, Accreditation & Access and Workforce and Volunteer Management, to ensure the smooth, efficient and effective operation at the venue for all constituent groups.
  • Establish constructive communication channels between FIFA, FIFA27, venue and local authorities and stakeholders.
  • Co-ordinate with all stakeholders (i.e. Host City authorities, venue operators, public transport, police & emergency services) at a venue level through regular coordinated meetings and/or workshops, to ensure the smooth running of events at the venue.
  • To integrate all relevant operational plans into effective venue plans.
  • To assess and validate FIFA’s event requirements to the reality of the venue.
  • Integration of all relevant functional area operational plans into the stadium environment.
  • Risk identification and mitigation across the venue.
  • Supervise and support stadium renovation and construction projects, assuring FIFA requirements are met.
  • Contribution to project management and knowledge management initiatives including event debriefs, and knowledge capture and documentation activities.
  • Contribution to workshops, seminars and meetings with FIFA, FIFA27, Host Country and site authorities.
  • Coordination of policies, requirements and planning with FIFA, FIFA27, Host Country and site authorities.
  • Co-ordination, planning and delivery of official test events.
  • Plan, manage and implement a good quality and cost-efficient on-site support, service and operations for all relevant FIFA departments as well as other stakeholders (i.e. sponsors, service providers, etc.).
  • Organize and lead Stadium Inspection Tours.
  • Full support to functional areas on site visits, activities and post inspection BIM360 follow up.
  • Manage and review the Stadium budget including regular reporting.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Minimum 8 years of management experience in multi-purpose arenas, professional sports clubs, or large-scale international sporting events.
  • Proven ability to lead large, multidisciplinary teams with strong stakeholder management skills across international and multicultural environments.
  • Excellent communication and crisis management skills, with the ability to remain calm under pressure and provide decisive leadership.
  • Strong knowledge of event planning, operations, and project management processes.
  • Familiarity with the host stadium and its operational environment will be considered an asset.
  • Demonstrated experience in the development and integration of operational plans across multiple functional areas (e.g., security, spectator services, media, broadcast, hospitality).
  • Experience in budgeting, financial oversight, and resource management for large-scale events.
  • Strong understanding of health & safety, risk management, and security regulations in stadium operations.
  • Proven track record in managing complex international projects involving multiple stakeholders and authorities.

Education

  • University degree in appropriate subject (or adequate training/vocational education).
  • Bilingual - Brazilian Portuguese and English.
  • Strong administrative and IT skills including MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong team player, able to work collaboratively while meeting tight deadlines.
  • Solution-oriented mindset with persistence, resilience, and a positive attitude under pressure.
  • Ability to prioritize and manage high workloads efficiently during peak operational periods.
  • Sound judgment, critical problem-solving ability, and capacity to make key decisions under pressure.

Brand & Marketing Designer (Part-Time / Fractional)

We are building a differentiated brand in a brutally competitive AI/SaaS market. This is not a “make it pretty” gig. We want a designer with exceptional taste, strong opinions, and the instincts to ship visuals that move metrics.

Remote-first, part‑time freelance (5–20 h/week) with a clear path to full‑time within 12 months based on impact. Compensation set based on agreed hours/work scope. Reports to the Founder/Marketing/Head of Design.

What You’ll Do

  • Partner with Growth, Product, Marketing, and Founders to own day‑to‑day marketing design: ad creatives, product marketing animations, landing pages, websites, email visuals, partner assets.
  • Evolve and guard our brand system (typography, colour, illustration, motion, component libraries) across web and product‑adjacent surfaces.
  • Turn complex AI features into clear, conversion‑ready visuals (diagrams, product mockups, short motion snippets).
  • Rapidly prototype A/B test variants; ship multiple creative angles per week.
  • Build reusable templates for speed (social sets, launch kits, webinar packs, sales one‑pagers).
  • Collaborate on campaign concepts end‑to‑end—insight, mood‑board, concept, production, iteration.
  • Maintain a tidy Figma workspace (components, tokens, documentation) so others can self‑serve.

  • Asset turnaround under 48 h for priority requests; weekly creative batch drops.

  • Thought‑leadership as a bold brand within AI SaaS, enhancing our designs.

  • 6+ years hands‑on design experience in SaaS/AI (agency or in‑house) with deep knowledge of category patterns.

  • Bonus: light motion experience (After Effects or Figma video exports).

Bonus Points

  • 2–4+ years in marketing/advertising environments (performance creative, concepting, storytelling).

title: Marketing Manager
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder‑led, profitable, and growing.

Marketing Manager

Canonical is looking for a creative and data‑driven Marketing Manager to lead marketing initiatives that generate awareness, engagement, and pipeline for our products. This role blends strategy with hands‑on execution, from crafting compelling campaigns and driving demand generation, to collaborating cross‑functionally with Sales, SDRs, Product, Communications, and Alliances.

As a key contributor to our marketing team, you’ll take ownership of high‑impact programs including integrated campaigns, product launches, events, and account‑based marketing. You’ll play a pivotal role in connecting our products with the right audiences whether enterprise customers, developers, or strategic partners.

You thrive in fast‑paced environments, love experimenting and optimizing based on data. You are passionate about technology, marketing and the use of technology in marketing. You bring curiosity, ownership, and a strong desire to make things better for your campaigns, your team, and your own growth. If you enjoy building smart, scalable marketing engines with a bit of creative flair, we’d love to hear from you.

Location: Remote, EMEA

What your day will look like

  • Own end‑to‑end go‑to‑market planning and campaign execution across portfolios, territory or vertical.
  • Develop and lead marketing programs that engage with prospects to drive opportunities and revenue.
  • Collaborate closely with other marketing teams to improve content performance and conversion through data‑driven insights.
  • Partner with events, content, paid media, and social media teams to execute integrated campaigns across channels.

What we are looking for in you

  • Experience in a marketing role in the technology sector (SaaS or enterprise IT preferred).
  • Data‑driven mindset with the ability to evaluate performance and optimize for impact.
  • Comfortable balancing strategy with hands‑on execution, a true self‑starter.
  • Strong storytelling skills—you know how to craft messaging that resonates with both technical and business audiences.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Adaptable, fast learner with a growth mindset and a passion for innovation.

What we offer you

  • Parental Leave
